display.title: Episode 208: The Lost Letter
display.summary_short: Leibel, who once refused the Baal Shem Tov's blessing, loses his fortune piece by piece until a long-lost letter turns up; plus Shema with a young guest and a Mitzvah Time quiz on honoring the Chumash.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi invites listeners to send their phone numbers for Mitzvah Time, then leads the Hakochainik march. Story time continues 'The Lost Letter' with a recap: Leibel, a wealthy man, told the Baal Shem Tov he needed no blessing, so the Baal Shem Tov gave him a sealed letter for Rabbi Shimon, but it slipped under a cedar closet and was forgotten. After a six-year-old guest leads the Shema, the story goes on. Messengers bring bad news again and again: a factory burns down, lightning sets his forest on fire, and over ten years his whole fortune disappears. Uncle Yossi explains that a tzaddik's blessing opens a channel for Hashem's goodness. Forced to sell his furniture, Leibel has the closet carried out, and there on the floor lies the lost letter, to be continued. In Mitzvah Time, Uncle Yossi teaches that the Chumash is unlike any other book because its words come from Hashem, and that we honor it by keeping it clean and washing our hands before using it; a listener answers the quiz questions by phone. He closes by urging listeners to share their blessings like Avraham Avinu by signing up friends for Tzivos Hashem.
display.lesson: Never turn down a tzaddik's blessing; and honor the Chumash, whose words come from Hashem himself.
